Operator’s field guide + MORSE ALPHABET

A dot lasts 1 beat; a dash lasts 3. Pause 1 beat between symbols and 3 between letters. The lamp and audio carry the same message. A correct answer earns 3 points, or 1 after revealing the written signal. Wrong answers can be retried.

Reference: ITU-R M.1677-1, International Morse code. Speed uses the 50-unit PARIS standard.
